title: fagara elegans
intro: Fagara elegans, commonly known as Japanese prickly ash, is a type of plant species in the Rutaceae family. This plant is valued for its medicinal properties and is traditionally used in various Asian cultures for its health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant effects. The therapeutic actions of Fagara elegans include pain relief, fever reduction, and digestive aid, attributed to its bioactive constituents such as limonoids, flavonoids, and alkaloids. These bioactive compounds are responsible for the plant's potential health benefits, making it a valuable resource in traditional medicine.
